verdict.rationale: A runtime probe of the public npm registry shows @babylonjs/core is published under Apache-2.0. That is a permissive open-source license with no royalty or per-install fee terms, and the llms.txt probe describes Babylon.js as an "open" game and rendering engine. Missing for 10: a first-party docs or licensing page stating the license and its commercial terms, and independent or community corroboration of royalty-free commercial use.
